name: Weird guy
text: Congratulations on making so much money. Thanks for that. But honestly, I'm too lazy to send you back to your world, and I'm too lazy to keep dealing with you because you're so boring.

name: You
text: So what you want to do now?

name: Weird guy
text: I took all your money, bought a bomb, and now I'm going to blow up the whole world.

text: Hello are you the new person that you come here?
